title: agent.run's resolved state type keeps the idle arm, so final.run.runId does not typecheck
rawReportMissing: The issue was filed already triaged: the body carries its own acceptance criteria, has no 'Original report (verbatim)' block and was never edited, so no pre-triage text exists. Seeding from it hands triage the answer.
enriched:
## Summary
`await agent.run(...)` resolves only on a settled run, but its resolved type still includes the never-started `idle` arm — which carries no `runId`. So `final.run.runId` is a type error on a value that always has one at runtime. The type is wider than the promise.

Split out of #151, whose remaining items are the typechecker-setup gap and a docs polish list.

## What is true, read at `origin/main`
`src/internal/flow/monitored-run/index.ts:233`–`:240` defines the run slice as a discriminated union:

```ts
| (RunCore<Stage> & { readonly phase: "idle" })
| (RunCore<Stage> & { readonly phase: "running"; readonly runId: string })
| (RunCore<Stage> & { readonly phase: "stale";   readonly runId: string })
| (RunCore<Stage> & { readonly phase: "done";    readonly runId: string })
| { readonly phase: "failed"; readonly runId: string; … }
```

The omission is deliberate and documented at `:213`: `idle` "carries no `runId` (identity is minted at `start`) … its OWN phase, not a `running` run wearing an empty-string `runId`". That design is right and this issue does not propose changing it.

The defect is downstream. `agent.run` (`src/agent/define-agent.ts:325`) is documented to resolve on a settled run — "one already `done` resolves as it is" — and it mints a `runId` on the start path at `:479`. A promise that cannot resolve `idle` should not be typed as if it can. Today a reader who reaches for the run id off the resolved value gets a compile error and no obvious next move.

## What "fixed" looks like
Narrow the resolved type so `idle` is excluded — e.g. the resolved state's `run` is the settled subset of the union — rather than adding `runId` to `idle`. Whatever shape is chosen, `final.run.runId` must typecheck without a cast or a redundant `phase` guard.

Triage note: check whether the same widening reaches `runtime.result()` and the tutorial's `DefinedAgentState<…>` alias before narrowing in one place only.

## Pointers
- `src/internal/flow/monitored-run/index.ts:213`, `:233`–`:240` — the union and the documented `idle` omission
- `src/agent/define-agent.ts:325`, `:479` — `agent.run`'s resolve contract and the `runId` mint
- `src/agent/types.ts:690`, `:736` — the `idle` status arm
- `docs/tutorial/build-a-durable-agent.md` — the reader who hits this; parent #151
- `MAINTAINING.md` — narrowing a public type's shape is a semver-surface change

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `const final = await agent.run(...); final.run.runId` typechecks under `tsc --noEmit` with no cast and no added `phase` guard, covered by a type-level test.
- [ ] The `idle` arm still carries no `runId` — the fix narrows what `run` can resolve, it does not widen the `idle` phase.
- [ ] A run resolved from an already-`done` stored Model typechecks the same way as a freshly started one.
- [ ] The PR body states whether `runtime.result()` and `DefinedAgentState` needed the same narrowing, and what it found.
- [ ] The semver impact of the narrowed public type is stated against `MAINTAINING.md`.
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test` pass.
